name: booking-summary
title: Booking summary
description: What you are about to book, as a list: service, date and time, who and where, the total set apart, and an edit link on every row.
docs: service and staff can be plain strings or objects ({ name, detail }, { name, role }); location is { name, address: [lines] } and is set in an <address> element. start is an ISO date-time, a Date or a timestamp and duration is in minutes: the row reads 'Tuesday 3 November 2026' with '10:00 to 11:00 · 1 hour' under it, written in locale and timeZone (pass both, so the server and the browser agree). price is { amount, currency, note? } with the amount in the currency's own minor units (9500 is 95.00 EUR, but 9,500 JPY, which has none) and is set apart in the footer; policy is the cancellation policy as one plain line under it. onEdit(part) adds an 'Edit' button to every row, and editHrefs makes a part a real link instead; without either the summary is read-only, as on a confirmation page. Each link is named for what it changes, from labels and not from the row's term: editService, editDateTime, editStaff, editLocation and editNotes ('Edit service', 'Edit date and time', 'Edit staff member', 'Edit location', 'Edit notes'), so the rows 'With' and 'Where' are never announced as 'Edit with' and 'Edit where'. Keep the visible word (labels.edit) inside each name when you translate them, so voice control matches what is on screen. confirmed adds a check mark and the heading 'Booking confirmed', and reference prints the booking reference. headingAs sets the heading level (h2 by default) and labels holds the fixed words for another language. It keeps no state and renders on the server.
